reason: At $24.99 for the first box it is about 83 cents a day, and the money-back guarantee means I am not stuck if it does nothing. The named lab report with the batch number is more than most TikTok Shop brands show, so I would try one box, not two.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? I would also want to check that the lab report is real before the second box.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not match the batch number or the lab could not be found, I would not buy. A bigger discount on two boxes would make me buy two.
